card.name: Setup words before a contrasting 'other/some' group
card.fires_on: Linking words or 'One'/'Some' that open the first half of a split, where the next clause will contrast one group or person with another ("some... others", "one... another"). Often follows 'which child', 'some individuals', or 'some use'.

modes.label: Joining a contrast
modes.description: A conjunction such as 'and', 'while' or 'or' that leads into the second, contrasting group.
modes.example: Some individuals recover completely from the disorder<< while>> other patients' symptoms become progressively worse.

modes.label: Opening a split
modes.description: 'One' or 'For' starting a sentence that will be followed by another/others.
modes.example: It also differs from person to person or from thing to thing.<< One>> person may learn something faster than others;

modes.label: Comma in a list of 'some' groups
modes.description: A comma after a 'some ...' clause that leads into the next group.
modes.example: some use only tampons<<,>> and some switch around

card.writes: It pushes toward words that refer to a set of items (these, the two) and away from 'one', 'ones' and 'none'.
card.plain: It fires at the point in a sentence where the text is about to say 'some do this, others do that'.
